Header24high exact day labels日 13 / 月 14 / 火 15 / 水 16. Thin neutral vertical column lines and3 horizontal hour grid lines. LEFT time labels7:00,8:00,9:00 aligned down successive40px rows. Exactly3 event blocks, original source controls placement: Sunday block near first hour, paleYELLOW with exact朝食; Monday block starts halfway between7 and8 and lasts about1.5hours, paleLAVENDER with exact企画の準備; Wednesday short block at same start as Monday, palePINK with exact空港へ. Preserve exact16 Japanese/text blocks and all states. No extra save button, sidebar, page header, AppIcon section, phone or invented features. Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: White canvas/calendar/radio rows, fine neutral grid/outlines. Pale original yellow/lavender/pink event colors retained. Forest outline and filled radio only for Automatic selection; no mint row wash or all-green calendar.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
